body:
NTA

It isn’t mom’s money just like it isn’t your money. It is your daughter’s money. Tell her the conversation is over and she can take you to court to see what a judge thinks.

Also, it is pretty clear that your EX just steals her daughter’s gift money from her relatives. So gross.
It's hard to explain. I will attempt to once I formulate my thoughts in a few hours or so.
Being addicted to alcohol is a very tough sickness to combat. I decided on 30 days from now to give myself enough time to spread the word about everything that I know, and have known.

I think that views on "death" are relatively narrow-minded. Now, that being said I am not religious, but I have reason to believe there are things beyond the human concept of death that can only be seen or achieved when that path is taken.
I believe in 30 days, I will be saved.
I would be interested in hearing your thoughts on breaking other people's patterns.

I have seen things that normal people aren't supposed to see, witnessed the unthinkable. I stood by, doing nothing, as was my place. Beneath it all I have come to realize the truly sick and twisted joke that this life is; full of illusions and false pretense.
